entities.name: St. Rose Cathedral, Santa Rosa de Copán
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Rose Cathedral, also called Santa Rosa de Copán Cathedral, is the main church of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Santa Rosa de Copán in the city of Santa Rosa de Copán in the Central American country of Honduras. The church is dedicated to St. Rose of Lima.
